sentences.en: Today, a former Senate aide to Joe Biden has accused him of assaulting her in 1993.
sentences.zh: 今天，乔·拜登的一名前参议院幕僚指控他在1993年对其进行了人身攻击。

sentences.en: My colleague, Lisa Lair, examines the allegation.
sentences.zh: 我的同事莉萨·莱尔对这一指控进行了调查。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, April 14th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月14日，星期二。

sentences.en: Lisa, when did you begin reporting this story?
sentences.zh: 莉萨，你是何时开始报道这个故事的？

sentences.en: So, about a year ago, we were reporting on allegations from a number of women who came out and said that Joe Biden had touched them in ways that made them feel uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 大概是一年前，我们开始报道一些女性的指控，她们站出来说，乔·拜登曾以让她们感到不舒服的方式触摸过她们。

sentences.en: Tonight, Joe Biden is facing troubling accusations.
sentences.zh: 今晚，乔·拜登正面临令人不安的指控。

sentences.en: Nevada Democrat Lucy Flores claims the former vice president inappropriately touched and kissed her head before a rally in 2014.
sentences.zh: 内华达州民主党人露西·弗洛雷斯声称，在2014年的一场集会之前，这位前副总统不恰当地触摸并亲吻了她的头部。

sentences.en: Maybe it was a squeeze on the shoulder.
sentences.zh: 也许是捏了一下肩膀。

sentences.en: Maybe he smelled their hair.
sentences.zh: 也许他闻了闻她们的头发。

sentences.en: Out of nowhere, I feel Joe Biden put his hands on my shoulders, get up very close to me from behind,
sentences.zh: 毫无征兆地，我感觉到乔·拜登把手放在我的肩膀上，从后面靠我非常近，

sentences.en: lean in, smell my hair, and then plant a slow kiss on the top of my head.
sentences.zh: 俯下身闻我的头发，然后在我头顶轻轻地吻了一下。

sentences.en: But this was all happening in public, at campaign rallies, at fundraisers.
sentences.zh: 但这都是在公开场合发生的，在竞选集会上，在筹款活动上。

sentences.en: He put his hands around my head and pulled me in.
sentences.zh: 他把手环绕在我的头上把我拉了过去。

sentences.en: Former congressional aide Amy Lappos told CBS News Tonight that Joe Biden reached for her face and rubbed noses with her during a fundraiser in Greenwich, Connecticut, in 2009.
sentences.zh: 前国会幕僚艾米·拉波斯今晚对哥伦比亚广播公司新闻部表示，2009年在康涅狄格州格林威治的一场筹款活动中，乔·拜登曾伸手摸她的脸并与她碰鼻子。

sentences.en: And, you know, we in the newsroom and in the media were really grappling with how to think and talk about this behavior.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们新闻界和媒体一直在努力思考和讨论这种行为。

sentences.en: This wasn't anything like we had normally come up in a lot of these discussions around Me Too, like Harvey Weinstein or any of that.
sentences.zh: 这与我们在许多围绕“Me Too”运动的讨论中通常遇到的情况完全不同，比如哈维·韦恩斯坦或诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: And for the record, I don't believe that it was a bad intention.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我不认为他怀有恶意。

sentences.en: I'm not in any way suggesting that I felt sexually assaulted or sexually harassed.
sentences.zh: 我绝不是在暗示我感到自己遭到性侵犯或性骚扰。

sentences.en: I felt invaded.
sentences.zh: 我感到被侵犯了。

sentences.en: I felt that there was a violation of my personal space.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我的个人空间受到了践踏。

sentences.en: The women talking about these allegations weren't quite sure what to call it.
sentences.zh: 谈论这些指控的女性并不太确定该如何称呼它。

sentences.en: Some of them said quite vehemently that they didn't consider it sexual harassment,
sentences.zh: 其中一些人强烈表示她们不认为这是性骚扰，

sentences.en: but they wanted the former vice president to be aware of his behavior and how it could make people feel.
sentences.zh: 但她们希望前副总统能够意识到自己的行为以及这会如何让人感到不适。

sentences.en: Others had a slightly different perspective.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则有稍微不同的看法。

sentences.en: They thought it was something closer to sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 她们认为这更接近性骚扰。

sentences.en: So this goes on for really a couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以这种情况确实持续了几个星期。

sentences.en: And in the end, Biden, he doesn't quite apologize.
sentences.zh: 最后，拜登并没有真正道歉。

sentences.en: Today, I want to talk about just as a support and encouragement that I've made to women and some men that have made them uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 今天，我想谈谈我给予女性以及部分男性的支持和鼓励，这些举动曾让他们感到不适。

sentences.en: But he comes out and he makes an online video where he says that he has a very touchy-feely kind of political style.
sentences.zh: 但他发表了一段网络视频，在视频中他说自己有一种非常喜欢肢体接触的从政风格。

sentences.en: In my career, I've always tried to make a human connection.
sentences.zh: 在我的职业生涯中，我一直努力建立人与人之间的联系。

sentences.en: That's my responsibility, I think.
sentences.zh: 我认为那是我的责任。

sentences.en: I shake hands.
sentences.zh: 我与人握手。

sentences.en: I hug people.
sentences.zh: 我拥抱人们。

sentences.en: I grab men and women by the shoulders and say, you can do this.
sentences.zh: 我抓着男男女女的肩膀说，你能做到这一点。

sentences.en: But he recognizes that times have changed, and perhaps he needs to change with them and be more respectful of people's space.
sentences.zh: 但他认识到时代已经变了，或许他也需要随之改变，更加尊重人们的空间。

sentences.en: You know, social norms have begun to change.
sentences.zh: 你知道，社会规范已经开始改变了。

sentences.en: They've shifted.
sentences.zh: 它们已经发生了转变。

sentences.en: And the boundaries of protecting personal space have been reset.
sentences.zh: 保护个人空间的界限已经被重新设定。

sentences.en: And I get it.
sentences.zh: 我明白。

sentences.en: I get it.
sentences.zh: 我明白。

sentences.en: I hear what they're saying.
sentences.zh: 我听到了他们的声音。

sentences.en: I understand it.
sentences.zh: 我理解。

sentences.en: And I'll be much more mindful.
sentences.zh: 我会更加注意的。

sentences.en: That's my responsibility.
sentences.zh: 那是我的责任。

sentences.en: My responsibility, and I'll meet it.
sentences.zh: 我的责任，我会做到的。

sentences.en: And then I met Tara Reid.
sentences.zh: 然后我遇到了塔拉·里德。

sentences.en: And she had called me with sort of similar kind of story.
sentences.zh: 她给我打过电话，讲述了类似的故事。

sentences.en: Joe Biden had touched her.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登曾经触摸过她。

sentences.en: He'd put his hands in her hair.
sentences.zh: 他把手伸进她的头发里。

sentences.en: He'd touched her shoulders, all in public, in ways that really made her feel uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 他触摸她的肩膀，全都是在公开场合，这些举动确实让她感到很不舒服。

sentences.en: But her story had a little bit of a different twiSt.
sentences.zh: 但她的故事有一个稍有不同的转折。

sentences.en: So she, at the time, had been working in his Senate office.
sentences.zh: 当时，她曾在他的参议院办公室工作。

sentences.en: And this was about, I think, December 1992 to August 1993.
sentences.zh: 我想这大概是在1992年12月到1993年8月期间。

sentences.en: She was a low-level staffer, a staff assistant.
sentences.zh: 她是一名低级别的工作人员，一名员工助理。

sentences.en: And she said that the touching had gone beyond just sort of hands in the hair and squeezes of the shoulder, that there had been harassment.
sentences.zh: 她说这种触摸已经超出了诸如摸头发和捏肩膀的范畴，确实存在骚扰行为。

sentences.en: She says he had asked her to serve drinks at a cocktail party.
sentences.zh: 她说他曾要求她在鸡尾酒会上端茶递水。

sentences.en: He had commented on her looks in the office in front of other people.
sentences.zh: 他在办公室里当着其他人的面评头论足她的外貌。

sentences.en: And that she felt that he had cultivated a culture in his office that, you know, fostered and permitted this kind of sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 她觉得他在办公室里营造了一种文化，你知道，助长并容许了这种性骚扰。

sentences.en: And what did you do with Reid's story, with that reporting?
sentences.zh: 那你对里德的故事以及这篇报道做了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I talked to her.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我和她谈过。

sentences.en: I talked to her friend who corroborated a lot of what she was telling me.
sentences.zh: 我和她的朋友谈过，她朋友证实了她对我说的大部分内容。

sentences.en: We did use her allegations to call a whole bunch of people who had worked in Joe Biden's office in the 1990s, particularly the early 1990s,
sentences.zh: 我们确实利用她的指控，打电话给了一大群在20世纪90年代、特别是90年代初曾在乔·拜登办公室工作过的人，

sentences.en: which was the period that Tara Reid was working there, to see if they remembered any kind of harassment, what the environment of the office was at the time.
sentences.zh: 也就是塔拉·里德在那里工作的时期，看看他们是否记得任何形式的骚扰，以及当时办公室的环境是怎样的。

sentences.en: But we didn't really come up with anything all that surprising or explosive.
sentences.zh: 但我们并没有发现任何令人感到意外或具有爆炸性的东西。

sentences.en: Nobody really confirmed her account at that time.
sentences.zh: 当时没有人真正证实她的说法。

sentences.en: So we actually didn't end up reporting them in the paper.
sentences.zh: 所以我们实际上并没有在报纸上报道这些。

sentences.en: We had already reported on a number of allegations from these women who said that they were uncomfortable with Joe Biden's touching.
sentences.zh: 我们已经报道了许多女性的指控，她们称自己对乔·拜登的触摸感到不适。

sentences.en: And we just sort of moved on.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就把这页翻过去了。

sentences.en: And the political world did, too.
sentences.zh: 政界也是如此。

sentences.en: Everyone moved on to the next battle.
sentences.zh: 每个人都转向了下一场战斗。

sentences.en: There was the Mueller report to contend with.
sentences.zh: 还有“通俄门”报告需要应付。

sentences.en: And then a really competitive primary presidential debate started.
sentences.zh: 接着，一场竞争激烈的总统初选辩论开始了。

sentences.en: So this issue of the unwanted touching and Tara's story just never came back up.
sentences.zh: 所以，这种不速之触的问题和塔拉的故事就再也没有被提起过。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And Lisa, do you think that has something to do with the fact that Biden confronted this, talked about it, and said he was learning from it?
sentences.zh: 莉萨，你认为这是否与拜登正视这一点、谈论此事并表示他在从中吸取教训有关？

sentences.en: Oh, for sure.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: But he was really forced into confronting it.
sentences.zh: 但他确实是被迫正视这一点的。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: this was a period in March and April before Biden had formally announced his presidential bid where he was going through the process of reconciling a lot of his record with the current mores of the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 这是在3月和4月的一个时期，在拜登正式宣布竞选总统之前，他正在经历一个过程，将他的许多过往记录与民主党当前的风气进行调和。

sentences.en: He was dealing with his criminal justice record.
sentences.zh: 他在处理他的刑事司法记录。

sentences.en: He was dealing with his positions on abortion and sort of moving to the left with the party.
sentences.zh: 他在处理自己在堕胎问题上的立场，并随党内趋向左翼进行调整。

sentences.en: And so I think that quasi-apology video was part of that process.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为那个准道歉视频就是该过程的一部分。

sentences.en: You have a Democratic Party that's acutely aware of issues of racial and gender bias.
sentences.zh: 你有一个对种族和性别偏见问题极其敏感的民主党。

sentences.en: And Biden had to eventually reconcile those criticisms, whether he felt they were fair or not, with where the party was.
sentences.zh: 不管拜登是否认为这些批评是公平的，他最终都必须将这些批评与党派的现状调和起来。

sentences.en: But ultimately, you know, he didn't pay much of a price for it.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，你知道，他为此付出的代价并不大。

sentences.en: You know, he announced his campaign a couple, three or so weeks later.
sentences.zh: 你知道，两三个星期后他就宣布参选了。

sentences.en: His opponents never made an issue of this.
sentences.zh: 他的对手从未拿这件事做文章。

sentences.en: And everything sort of moved on.
sentences.zh: 一切都翻篇了。

sentences.en: Okay, so what happens next?
sentences.zh: 好吧，接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, you have the primary race.
sentences.zh: 嗯，接着是初选。

sentences.en: So Biden, as we all know, nosedives.
sentences.zh: 所以拜登，正如我们所知，支持率暴跌。

sentences.en: Then he comes back up.
sentences.zh: 然后他又回升了。

sentences.en: He becomes the frontrunner.
sentences.zh: 他成了领跑者。

sentences.en: And around that time.
sentences.zh: 大约在那个时候。

sentences.en: Hello and welcome to the Katie Halper Show.
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎收看凯蒂·哈珀秀。

sentences.en: A woman goes on a podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 一位女性上了一个播客节目。

sentences.en: Where would you like to start?
sentences.zh: 你想从哪里开始？

sentences.en: Where does the story start for you?
sentences.zh: 对你来说故事是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: Well, the story starts when I went to work for Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 嗯，故事是从我开始为乔·拜登工作时讲起的。

sentences.en: And levels a really serious, serious accusation against Joe Biden, which is basically that he sexually assaulted her.
sentences.zh: 并对乔·拜登提出了非常严重、极其严重的指控，基本上就是指控他对她实施了性侵犯。

sentences.en: And my body, I was shaking everywhere because it was cold all of a sudden.
sentences.zh: 我的身体，全身都在发抖，因为突然间变得好冷。

sentences.en: And I was, I don't know, I felt like I was shaking just everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我，我不知道，我感觉自己浑身都在颤抖。

sentences.en: And I was trying to grasp what had just happened and what I should do.
sentences.zh: 我当时在试图理解刚刚发生了什么以及我该怎么办。

sentences.en: And that woman who tells her story in great detail on this podcast is Tara Reid.
sentences.zh: 而那个在这个播客上极为详细地讲述自己故事的女性就是塔拉·里德。

sentences.en: So what are you thinking at this point?
sentences.zh: 那你此时作何感想？

sentences.en: Because you had already talked to this woman and she had not mentioned this kind of accusation, right?
sentences.zh: 因为你之前已经和这位女性谈过，而她当时并没有提到这种指控，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, I must admit, I'm a little confused because it didn't come up at all.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我必须承认，我有点困惑，因为这件事根本没有被提及。

sentences.en: And so the first thing I did was pull up my notes.
sentences.zh: 所以我做的第一件事就是调出我的笔记。

sentences.en: And when I look over my notes and I read the story she had told me a year ago, there's some holes in that story she told me.
sentences.zh: 当我查看我的笔记并阅读她一年前对我说过的话时，她当时讲的故事里有一些漏洞。

sentences.en: Things that I remember thinking that her reaction was maybe a bit extreme for what she said she was experiencing in the office at the time.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时曾想过，对于她在办公室里所经历的事情，她的反应可能有点反应过度。

sentences.en: That maybe make a little more sense if this other thing had in fact happened, this sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 如果确有其事——即那场性侵真的发生过，那么这些事情或许就更好理解了。

sentences.en: So I wondered, you know, first of all, had she been truthful the first time around?
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，首先，她第一次说的是实话吗？

sentences.en: Was she being truthful now?
sentences.zh: 她现在说的是实话吗？

sentences.en: And also whether I had asked the right questions.
sentences.zh: 还有就是我是否问对了问题。

sentences.en: Did I miss something because I hadn't called back?
sentences.zh: 我是不是因为没有回电而漏掉了什么？

sentences.en: Because I got caught up with the dynamics of this primary?
sentences.zh: 因为我被这场初选的动态给缠住了？

sentences.en: So at this point, after Tara Reade has gone on this podcast, she has made this claim and you're trying to figure out why she didn't first tell you that same information.
sentences.zh: 所以在塔拉·里德上了这个播客、提出了这一指控之后，你正在弄清楚她为什么没有最先告诉你同样的信息。

sentences.en: How are you now approaching this story journalistically?
sentences.zh: 你现在是如何从新闻角度来处理这篇报道的？

sentences.en: So I think we all quickly agreed that it wasn't a question of whether we would approach the story, but how.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我们很快就达成一致，问题不在于我们是否要报道这个故事，而是该如何报道。

sentences.en: This was a woman who was making very serious allegations of sexual assault with her name attached publicly against the man who is more than likely to become the Democratic nominee for president.
sentences.zh: 这是一位女性，公开附上自己的真名，对一位极有可能成为民主党总统候选人的男性提出了非常严重的性侵指控。

sentences.en: So we had to grapple with these claiMs.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须应对这些指控。

sentences.en: The question was how.
sentences.zh: 问题在于如何应对。

sentences.en: And I think the natural thing to do, really the human thing to do, is to go into a story like this and say, do you believe or not believe the person who's making the accusation?
sentences.zh: 我想很自然的事情，真正符合人性的做法，是介入这样一个故事并说：你究竟是相信还是不相信这个提出指控的人？

sentences.en: But that's not the journalistic thing to do.
sentences.zh: 但这不是新闻工作者该做的事。

sentences.en: We're not judges.
sentences.zh: 我们不是法官。

sentences.en: We're not the jury.
sentences.zh: 我们不是陪审团。

sentences.en: We're not the police department.
sentences.zh: 我们不是警察局。

sentences.en: I was really focused on what we could show to be true and what we could show to not be true.
sentences.zh: 我真正关注的是我们能证明什么是真的，以及我们能证明什么是假的。

sentences.en: What we had corroboration on and what we didn't have corroboration on.
sentences.zh: 我们有什么证据来佐证，又有什么没有证据佐证。

sentences.en: And what kind of facts we could give voters and the American public about this whole incident that's already out in the world and being passed around quite actively on social media.

sentences.en: So Lisa, tell me about this, I guess, second round of communications that you have with Tara Reid after she claims that Joe Biden has assaulted her.
sentences.zh: 丽莎，能跟我聊聊这个吗？我想这是你在塔拉·里德声称遭到乔·拜登袭击后，与她进行的第二轮交流。

sentences.zh: 我问她的第一个显而易见的问题是，为什么我们在一年前交谈时，她没有告诉我这些指控。

sentences.zh: 她告诉我，尽管这些内容没有发表在《纽约时报》上，但它们曾发表在当地的一家报纸上。

sentences.en: And the feedback she got from that being out there, the kind of death threats and harassment online, made her reluctant to tell the rest of her story.

sentences.zh: 所以我们把这些都谈透了。

sentences.en: And then eventually I say to her that I need her to tell me the story that she told on that podcast in a way that we can use on the record.
sentences.zh: 后来我终于对她说，我需要她把她在那个播客上讲的故事，以一种我们能公开记录并使用的方式再讲一遍。

sentences.zh: 你想从哪里开始？

sentences.zh: 接下来我要讲的故事，全部来自塔拉·里德的叙述。

sentences.en: So it's 1993 in the spring sometime, and she's working as a staff assistant in Joe Biden's Senate office.
sentences.zh: 那是1993年的某个春天，她在乔·拜登的参议员办公室担任员工助理。

sentences.en: And one day she's at work and her supervisor comes up to her and has this athletic bag, this gym bag, and asked her if she would find the sender and bring him his gym bag.
sentences.zh: 有一天她在上班，她的主管走过来，拿着一个运动包，也就是健身包，问她能不能找到送包的人，把健身包给他送过去。

sentences.en: She just said, take him his gym bag, hurry.
sentences.zh: 她只是说，快把健身包拿给他。

sentences.en: And she was like, he'll meet you.
sentences.zh: 她还说，他会去见你的。

sentences.en: He's down towards the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 他就在靠近国会大厦的地方。

sentences.en: So she heads down and finds him somewhere in the Capitol complex of offices.
sentences.zh: 于是她走过去，在国会大厦办公区的某个地方找到了他。

sentences.en: And I ran into him, like I saw him, and he acknowledged me.
sentences.zh: 我撞见了他，就像我看到了他一样，他也认出了我。

sentences.en: He was talking to someone.
sentences.zh: 他当时正在和别人说话。

sentences.en: They walked away.
sentences.zh: 他们走开了。

sentences.en: And then he said, come here, Tara.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，过来，塔拉。

sentences.en: And then he smiled at me, greeted me.
sentences.zh: 接着他向我微笑，跟我打招呼。

sentences.en: And she says, hello, Senator.
sentences.zh: 她说，我打招呼说，你好，参议员。

sentences.en: I called him Senator.
sentences.zh: 我叫他参议员。

sentences.en: I didn't call him Joe.
sentences.zh: 我没有叫他乔。

sentences.en: And I handed him the bag with my right hand.
sentences.zh: 我用右手把包递给了他。

sentences.en: I remember that.
sentences.zh: 我记得很清楚。

sentences.en: And the next thing she remembers, he's pinned her up against a wall, which she remembers as being very, very cold.
sentences.zh: 她记得的下一件事是，他把她按在了一面墙上，她记得那面墙非常非常冰冷。

sentences.en: And he's kissing her.
sentences.zh: 他在吻她。

sentences.en: It happened at once.
sentences.zh: 这一切瞬间发生了。

sentences.en: And that's what's so hard about telling this story.
sentences.zh: 这也是讲述这个故事最艰难的地方。

sentences.en: Like he's talking to me and his hands are everywhere and everything's happening at once very quickly.
sentences.zh: 就像他在跟我说话，他的双手到处乱摸，所有事情都在极短的时间内同时发生。

sentences.en: This happened like in under two minutes.
sentences.zh: 这大概在两分钟内就发生了。

sentences.en: And according to Tara, he reaches his hand under her shirt.
sentences.zh: 据塔拉回忆，他把手伸进了她的衬衫底下。

sentences.en: She remembers she was wearing a cream-colored blouse, grabs her left breaSt.
sentences.zh: 她记得自己当时穿着一件米色衬衫，他抓住了她的左胸。

sentences.en: He used his knee to part my knees because my legs went together.
sentences.zh: 他用膝盖分开了我的膝盖，因为我的双腿并拢着。

sentences.en: And he went kind of like down my spurt.
sentences.zh: 他的动作有点像顺着我的裙子往下。

sentences.en: And then as he's like parting my legs with his knee, he like went up and then just like went under.
sentences.zh: 然后，当他用膝盖分开我的腿时，他向上移了一下，然后就直接伸了进去。

sentences.en: And then, of course, yeah, he was able to do what he did, which was he took, it felt like one or two fingers, and inserted them in my vagina.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，是的，他做成了他所做的事，感觉就像用了一根或两根手指，插入了我的阴道。

sentences.en: And at that point, he's kissing her and he says to her, she says, do you want to go somewhere else?
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他吻着她，对她说——她说，你想去别的地方吗？

sentences.zh: 她说，他试图吻她的嘴，但她把头转开了。

sentences.en: And then he pulled back because I wasn't responding to him.
sentences.zh: 然后他退开了，因为我没有回应他。

sentences.en: I wasn't kissing him back.
sentences.zh: 我没有吻他回去。

sentences.en: I completely froze up.
sentences.zh: 我整个人完全僵住了。

sentences.en: And he had kind of lifted me up.
sentences.zh: 他当时把我整个人提了起来。

sentences.en: So I was like up on my, you know, tippy toes almoSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我差不多是踮着脚尖的。

sentences.en: And then he looks back and he looks at me.
sentences.zh: 然后他回过头看着我。

sentences.en: And he says, according to her, come on, man, I heard you liked me.
sentences.zh: 据她回忆，他说，拜托，老兄，我听说你喜欢我。

sentences.en: And then he smiled.
sentences.zh: 接着他笑了。

sentences.en: But then when I looked at his eyes, he was angry.
sentences.zh: 但当我看着他的眼睛时，他是生气的。

sentences.en: And she said she remembers standing there just kind of frozen.
sentences.zh: 她说她记得自己站在那里，整个人几乎僵住了。

sentences.en: And she felt almost a little bad, like she had put him in a bad position.
sentences.zh: 她甚至感到有点不好意思，仿佛是她把他置于了一个尴尬的境地。

sentences.en: She was wondering what she did to make him think that, you know, she would be interested in this.
sentences.zh: 她在想自己做了什么，才会让他觉得，你知道的，她会对这感兴趣。

sentences.en: And according to Tara, he looked at her and he said, he pointed at me and he just goes, you're, you're nothing to me.
sentences.zh: 据塔拉回忆，他看着她，指着她说道，你，你对我来说什么都不是。

sentences.en: And then he looked at me and he goes, nothing.
sentences.zh: 然后他看着我说道，什么都不是。

sentences.en: You're nothing to me.
sentences.zh: 你对我来说什么都不是。

sentences.en: Nothing.
sentences.zh: 什么都不是。

sentences.zh: 她觉得当时的自己一定露出了某种神情，或者眼神里有某种特殊的表情。

sentences.en: Because then he kind of took her by the shoulders and pat her shoulders and said, you're okay.
sentences.zh: 因为接着他抓住了她的肩膀，拍了拍她的肩膀说，你没事。

sentences.zh: 你很好。

sentences.zh: 她说，他几乎可以说是把她放了下来。

sentences.zh: 然后他走开了，顺着走廊走远了。

sentences.zh: 我知道我去了洗手间。

sentences.zh: 我知道我去了那里清理自己。

sentences.en: But I don't remember which restroom I went to in the Russell building or there.
sentences.zh: 但我记不清我去了罗素大楼里的哪个洗手间，还是其他地方。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But I know I did.
sentences.zh: 但我知道我确实去过。

sentences.en: But my vivid memory next is sitting.
sentences.zh: 但我接下来清晰的记忆是坐在那里。

sentences.en: I was trying to pull myself together in the back stairs at the Russell building with those big windows.
sentences.zh: 我正试图在罗素大楼带有大窗户的后楼梯那里让自己平静下来。

sentences.en: I remember just sitting on the stairs and nobody was there.
sentences.zh: 我记得自己只是坐在楼梯上，周围一个人也没有。

sentences.en: And just, like, my whole body, like, was literally, I couldn't control my shaking.
sentences.zh: 然后我的整个身体，字面意义上地，我无法控制地颤抖着。

sentences.en: I got, really, I remember just being so cold, so cold.
sentences.zh: 我真的，我只记得当时感觉好冷，好冷。

sentences.en: And then she headed home.
sentences.zh: 然后她动身回家。

sentences.en: She doesn't remember how she got there.
sentences.zh: 她不记得自己是怎么回去的了。

sentences.en: She doesn't remember whether she went back into the office and got her bag or talked to anybody.
sentences.zh: 她不记得自己有没有回办公室拿包，或者有没有跟任何人说话。

sentences.en: But she made it home to her apartment.
sentences.zh: 但她成功回到了自己的公寓。

sentences.en: The next thing I remember is being on the phone with my mom and crying and then arguing with her.
sentences.zh: 我记得的下一件事就是和妈妈通电话，哭泣，然后和她争吵。

sentences.en: And her mother tells her in fairly firm language that she needs to immediately file a police report.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲用相当严厉的语气告诉她，她必须立即去报警。

sentences.en: God, you know, she even swore at me.
sentences.zh: 天哪，你知道的，她甚至对我说了脏话。

sentences.en: She was not, like, being gentle and supportive.
sentences.zh: 她一点也不温柔，也不支持我。

sentences.en: And I understand because she wanted me to have evidence.
sentences.zh: 我能理解，因为她是希望我能保留证据。

sentences.en: And now I understand what she was trying to do.
sentences.zh: 现在我明白了她当时想做什么。

sentences.en: And I didn't then.
sentences.zh: 但当时我不懂。

sentences.en: But Tara doesn't do that.
sentences.zh: 不过塔拉并没有报警。

sentences.en: And does she say why she did not go to the police?
sentences.zh: 她有没有说为什么没有报警？

sentences.en: Well, what she says is that she basically just wanted the whole thing to go away, is what she told me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她告诉我，她基本上只是想让整件事消失。

sentences.en: She told me that after it happened, she took a shower.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，事情发生后，她冲了个澡。

sentences.en: She says she threw out all her clothes that she was wearing at the time.
sentences.zh: 她说她把当时穿的所有衣服都扔掉了。

sentences.en: I threw everything out.
sentences.zh: 我把所有东西都扔了。

sentences.en: Even the shoes.
sentences.zh: 连鞋子也是。

sentences.en: Everything.
sentences.zh: 所有东西。

sentences.en: She tells me that she called in sick to work, that she was sobbing uncontrollably.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我她给单位请了病假，当时哭得泣不成声。

sentences.en: It's like I just didn't want it until it happened.
sentences.zh: 就好像在事情发生前，我一直不希望它发生。

sentences.en: It just didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 它就是没发生。

sentences.en: And what does she say happens in the days and maybe even weeks after this alleged incident?
sentences.zh: 那她怎么形容这起所谓事件发生后的几天甚至几周里发生了什么？

sentences.en: So she tells me eventually she does go back to work.
sentences.zh: 所以她告诉我，最终她还是回去上班了。

sentences.en: And when she does, she says that she tells her immediate supervisor, who's Biden's personal secretary,
sentences.zh: 当她回去时，她说她把这件事告诉了自己的直接主管（也就是拜登的私人秘书），

sentences.en: as well as two top staffers in the office, the deputy chief of staff and the chief of staff, that she feels uncomfortable around Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 以及办公室里的两位高级幕僚——副幕僚长和幕僚长，告诉他们她在乔·拜登身边时感到很不舒服。

sentences.en: She never mentions the alleged assault, but she talks more about feeling uncomfortable with him touching her shoulders or tangling his hands in her hair.
sentences.zh: 她从未提及所谓的袭击，但她更多地谈到，对于他触摸她的肩膀或用手拨弄她的头发感到很不舒服。

sentences.en: And in her telling, the staff don't really do anything about that.
sentences.zh: 但在她的叙述中，工作人员并没有为此采取任何行动。

sentences.en: In fact, she feels that they kind of penalize her for bringing that forward.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她觉得他们因为她提出这件事而对她进行某种惩罚。

sentences.en: She says they strip her of one of her duties, which is supervising the interns.
sentences.zh: 她说他们剥夺了她的一项职责，即监督实习生。

sentences.en: She says they put her in a windowless office far from the rest of the staff.
sentences.zh: 她说他们把她调到了一间没有窗户、远离其他工作人员的办公室。

sentences.en: So at some point, she says that she goes to a Senate personnel office and files a formal complaint.
sentences.zh: 所以她声称，在某个时候，她去了参议院人事办公室并提交了一份正式投诉。

sentences.en: And what does she say was in this complaint?
sentences.zh: 那她说这份投诉里写了些什么？

sentences.en: She said that complaint really detailed the harassment and what she saw as retaliation in the office.
sentences.zh: 她说那份投诉详细描述了骚扰情况，以及她眼中办公室里的报复行为。

sentences.en: But she believes that that form eventually was returned to Biden's office, which would have been a flouting of what the official protocol was at that time.
sentences.zh: 但她认为那份表格最终还是被退回到了拜登的办公室，这在当时将是对官方既定程序的公然违背。

sentences.en: And once that complaint was returned to Biden's office, she says she was given a month to find a new job and basically eased out of her position.
sentences.zh: 而一旦投诉被退回拜登办公室，她说自己就被给了一个月的时间去找新工作，并基本上被逼离了岗位。

sentences.en: And so she started looking for another position on Capitol Hill, she says, and never ended up getting hired or finding anything.
sentences.zh: 于是她开始在国会山寻找另一个职位，她说，但最终也没有被录用或找到任何工作。

sentences.en: So Lisa, once Tara Reid has given you this account of an alleged attack, what do you do next?
sentences.zh: 那么丽莎，既然塔拉·里德已经向你讲述了这一遭到袭击的指控，你接下来会做什么？

sentences.en: So at this point, she's told me a lot of information and some really detailed information too.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一点上，她告诉我很多信息，其中也包括一些非常具体的信息。

sentences.en: So I start thinking about what can be corroborated, what we can show to be true and what we can show to be not true.
sentences.zh: 于是我开始思考什么可以被佐证，什么我们可以证明是真的，什么我们可以证明是假的。

sentences.en: And one thing that Tara mentions to me is that at the time she had called a friend and told her the whole story.
sentences.zh: 塔拉向我提及的一件事是，当时她曾给一个朋友打电话，把整件事都告诉了对方。

sentences.en: So I tracked down the friend and, you know, in large part, she corroborates the story that Tara had told me.
sentences.zh: 所以我找到了那个朋友，在很大程度上，她证实了塔拉告诉我的故事。

sentences.en: Tara tells me she also told her mother, her mother is deceased, so she can't be called.
sentences.zh: 塔拉告诉我她还把这件事告诉了她母亲，但她母亲已经去世了，所以无法进行求证。

sentences.en: And she told a version of her story to her brother, though not all the details.
sentences.zh: 她把故事的一个版本讲给了她的兄弟，尽管没有透露所有细节。

sentences.en: So I start trying to track down her brother.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始设法找到她的兄弟。

sentences.en: And she tells me she told a friend in 2008, after Jill Biden had been picked as Barack Obama's vice president,
sentences.zh: 她告诉我在2008年，吉尔·拜登被选为巴拉克·奥巴马的副总统候选人之后，

sentences.en: she had told a version of the story to that friend without all the details, but that something had happened to her.
sentences.zh: 她曾向那个朋友讲述过故事的一个版本，没有包含所有细节，但提到了她身上发生过一些事。

sentences.en: So I tracked down that friend and she confirms that account and some of the things that Tara tells me.
sentences.zh: 所以我找到了那个朋友，她证实了这种说法以及塔拉告诉我的某些事情。

sentences.en: Where does that leave you?
sentences.zh: 这让你处于什么境地？

sentences.zh: 所以这给我们留下了一些线索，但显然不足以佐证这整个故事。

sentences.en: We really only have the one friend with the full story.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上只有一个了解全貌的朋友。

sentences.en: And everyone else is just giving us bits and pieces.
sentences.zh: 而其他人只能给我们提供零星的碎片。

sentences.en: So that's not the kind of full corroboration that you're looking for as a journalist when you're trying to confirm, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，这并不是你作为记者在试图确认某些事情时所期待的那种完全的佐证，

sentences.en: really serious allegations and also really politically explosive allegations.
sentences.zh: 这些是非常严肃的指控，同时也是极具政治爆炸性的指控。

sentences.en: But at this point, it's time to turn to the Biden side of things.
sentences.zh: 但现在是时候转向拜登这一边了。

sentences.en: So along with my colleague, Sydney Ember, we start looking at who we can talk to.
sentences.zh: 因此，我和同事悉尼·恩伯（Sydney Ember）一起，开始寻找我们可以对话的人。

sentences.en: And we start by calling the three top staffers in the office at the time that Tara had mentioned she had spoken with and she had raised those complaints of harassment, too.
sentences.zh: 我们首先给办公室里当时的最高三位幕僚打了电话，塔拉曾提到她和他们谈过，并向他们提出过骚扰投诉。

sentences.en: All three of them say that a woman named Tara Reid never approached them with these kind of allegations.
sentences.zh: 这三个人都表示，一个叫塔拉·里德的人从未带着这种指控找过他们。

sentences.en: And two of them said they didn't remember her at all, even working in the office.
sentences.zh: 其中两人甚至表示，他们根本不记得她曾在办公室工作过。

sentences.en: So just to be clear, the three people that Tara Reid said she went to and told of Biden's behavior that made her uncomfortable, pretty senior people in his office,
sentences.zh: 所以为了弄清楚：塔拉·里德声称她曾去找过并告知其拜登让她感到不舒服的行为的那三个人，在办公室里算是相当高级的人物，

sentences.en: they say they have no recollection of that ever happening.
sentences.zh: 他们表示完全不记得发生过这种事。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: They have no recollection.
sentences.zh: 他们毫无印象。

sentences.en: And a lot of the former staffers are mystified by her account, too.
sentences.zh: 许多前工作人员对她的说法也感到迷惑不解。

sentences.en: They don't remember anything like this or anything, even the hint of anything like this.
sentences.zh: 他们不记得有任何类似的事情，甚至连这种事情的蛛丝马迹都不记得。

sentences.en: So they when Sydney and I call them, they're trying to reconcile themselves, her story with what they remember from working in that office.
sentences.zh: 所以当悉尼和我打电话给他们时，他们正试图在她的故事与他们在那个办公室工作的记忆之间寻找契合点。

sentences.en: A lot of them didn't want to talk on the record.
sentences.zh: 他们当中许多人不愿公开记录在案。

sentences.en: One who did said that at the time you knew who the good guys and bad guys were on the Senate, the places where offices where women would and would not want to work.
sentences.zh: 其中一位愿意公开的人说，当时你在参议院里很清楚谁是好人谁是坏人，哪些办公室是女性愿意或不愿意去工作的。

sentences.en: And she described Biden as one of the good guys.
sentences.zh: 她将拜登描述为好人之一。

sentences.en: So after that, we reach out to another group of people, which is the interns.
sentences.zh: 所以在那之后，我们联系了另一群人，也就是实习生。

sentences.en: And that's because Tara had told me that she supervised the interns and that she shared an office with these interns.
sentences.zh: 这是因为塔拉曾告诉我，她曾管理过实习生，并且她和这些实习生共用一间办公室。

sentences.en: So I reached two of them and they both tell me that they never heard of anything, never saw anything like the kind of harassment and assault Tara had been alleging.
sentences.zh: 所以我联系了其中两人，他们都告诉我，他们从未听说过任何事，也从未见过塔拉所声称的那种骚扰和袭击。

sentences.en: But that they did remember midway through their internship sometime in April, she had been suddenly removed as their boss and they never knew why and they never saw her again.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实记得在实习进行到一半时，大约在4月份，她突然被撤销了主管职务，他们从来不知道原因，也再也没有见过她。

sentences.en: So amid all this confusion, I remember that there's one thing that really could cut through all this and clarify exactly what did or did not happen.
sentences.zh: 因此，在所有这些混乱中，我记得有一件事真的可以切入这一切，并澄清到底发生了什么或没发生什么。

sentences.en: And that's this complaint that Tara had told me she filed in 1993 with this Senate office and that someone had written down.
sentences.zh: 那就是塔拉告诉过我她在1993年向这个参议院办公室提交的投诉，而且有人把它写了下来。

sentences.en: So we start trying to track down that complaint and we call the Federal Office of Personnel Management and they tell us to file a freedom of information request,
sentences.zh: 所以我们开始试图追踪那份投诉，我们打电话给联邦人事管理局，他们让我们提交一份信息自由法案申请，

sentences.en: which would take months, if not years.
sentences.zh: 这需要几个月，甚至几年时间。

sentences.en: And anyhow, we don't really know exactly what we're asking for because she doesn't remember the name of the office where she filed this complaint.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，我们其实并不知道我们在要求什么，因为她不记得她提交这起投诉的办公室叫什么名字了。

sentences.en: We call over to the Senate and we're able to get some employment records, but not this complaint.
sentences.zh: 我们打电话给参议院，并设法拿到了一些就业记录，但没有这份投诉。

sentences.en: So we basically look for this document and come up empty.
sentences.zh: 所以我们基本上找了这份文件，但一无所获。

sentences.en: It's unfindable in the end.
sentences.zh: 最后它根本找不到。

sentences.en: What about other aspects of Reed's life that might feel relevant?
sentences.zh: 里德生活中的其他方面可能会让人觉得相关呢？

sentences.en: I mean, possible political affiliations or motivations.
sentences.zh: 我是说，可能的政治倾向或动机。

sentences.en: How do you begin to think and report on those?
sentences.zh: 你如何开始思考和报道这些？

sentences.en: Well, so one thing that we want to be really sure of is that she is who she says she is and that this isn't someone in the midst of a heated presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我们真正想确定的一件事是，她就是她所说的那个人，而且这不是一个正处于激烈总统竞选中的人。

sentences.en: That's only, of course,
sentences.zh: 当然，这只是

sentences.en: going to get more heated by all expectations that is trying to push an agenda or possibly pull a fast one on the media to try to get claims that are untrue out there in the public.
sentences.zh: 根据所有预期会变得更加激烈，试图推动某种议程，或者可能在媒体身上耍花招，试图将不实指控公之于众。

sentences.en: So I really talked to her a lot about her political affiliation.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的和她大量谈论了她的政治倾向。

sentences.en: She describes herself as a third generation Democrat, but walks me through the fact that she liked Marianne Williamson.
sentences.zh: 她把自己描述为第三代民主党人，但向我梳理了她喜欢玛丽安·威廉姆森这一事实。

sentences.en: She really liked Elizabeth Warren and when California voted in the primary over Super Tuesday, she backed Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 她真的很喜欢伊丽莎白·沃伦，当加州在超级星期二的初选中投票时，她支持了伯尼·桑德斯。

sentences.en: But she insists that her motivation for this is not political, even though, you know,
sentences.zh: 但她坚称她这样做的动机不是政治性的，尽管，你知道，

sentences.en: I had watched as supporters of Sanders and supporters of President Trump really are the ones pushing this allegation out there on social media and really keeping the drumbeat up for people to investigate it.
sentences.zh: 我一直在观察，桑德斯的支持者和特朗普总统的支持者确实是把这个指控在社交媒体上推波助澜、并不断为人们调查它造势的人。

sentences.en: So that's one concern.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个担忧。

sentences.en: And there is this other sort of unusual detail, which is what?
sentences.zh: 还有另一个不太寻常的细节，是什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, she had written a fair amount in medium posts and on Twitter about her support for Russia and her respect for Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她曾在Medium文章和推特上写了相当多的内容，表达对俄罗斯的支持以及对弗拉基米尔·普京的尊重。

sentences.en: And so we read through all those medium posts.
sentences.zh: 所以我们通读了所有那些Medium文章。

sentences.en: Some of them had been pulled down, you know, off the Internet, but we found them.
sentences.zh: 其中一些已经被从互联网上撤下了，你知道的，但我们找到了。

sentences.en: We looked through those old Twitter posts and we really tried to investigate whether there could be some kind of nefarious agenda there.
sentences.zh: 我们浏览了那些旧推文，并真正试图调查那里是否存在某种邪恶的议程。

sentences.en: And she says that she was misguided.
sentences.zh: 而她则说她当时误入歧途了。

sentences.en: Tara Reid says that she had been working on a novel.
sentences.zh: 塔拉·里德说她当时正在写一部小说。

sentences.en: She's not anymore about Russia.
sentences.zh: 她现在不写了，是关于俄罗斯的。

sentences.en: And this was all part of her research.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都是她研究的一部分。

sentences.en: And she says that she doesn't have any respect for Vladimir Putin now, has never been to Russia.
sentences.zh: 她说她现在对弗拉基米尔·普京没有任何敬意，也从未去过俄罗斯。

sentences.en: So we decide that that's not so disqualifying that it prevents us from putting a version of her story in the paper.
sentences.zh: 所以我们认为这并没有达到会阻止我们在报纸上发表她故事某个版本的取消资格程度。

sentences.en: So how are you thinking about everything that you have reported at this point?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于你目前报道的一切，你是怎么想的？

sentences.en: And I assume in consultation with your editors, how are you planning to proceed?
sentences.zh: 我想在与你的编辑商量后，你打算如何进行？

sentences.en: Well, one thing we know is that we can't corroborate her story beyond the two friends and her brother.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们知道的一件事是，除了那两个朋友和她的兄弟之外，我们无法证实她的故事。

sentences.en: We know we can't find any documents.
sentences.zh: 我们知道我们找不到任何文件。

sentences.en: And we know that everyone who worked for Joe Biden is denying that anything like this ever happened or could have happened.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道，每个为乔·拜登工作过的人都在否认发生过或可能发生过任何类似的事情。

sentences.en: And we also know one other thing, and this is really important.
sentences.zh: 我们还知道另一件事，这非常重要。

sentences.en: As far as we've learned in our reporting, there is no pattern of this kind of behavior from Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 就我们在报道中所了解到的而言，乔·拜登没有这种行为模式。

sentences.en: What we had seen a year ago was a very different thing.
sentences.zh: 我们一年前看到的完全是另一回事。

sentences.en: It was, you know, touching in public, rubbing of shoulders or maybe touching of hair that made some women feel uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是公众场合的触碰、擦肩膀或者可能是摸头发，让一些女性感到不舒服。

sentences.en: This is an allegation of a sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 这是一起性侵指控。

sentences.en: Those things are not at all similar.
sentences.zh: 这两者根本不相似。

sentences.en: And in fact, what Tara Reade is alleging is a fairly singular act as far as we know.
sentences.zh: 事实上，据我们所知，塔拉·里德所指控的是一个相当独特的行为。

sentences.en: But the Democratic Party, they've really set a very high standard for taking these cases seriously, for taking allegations of sexual abuse seriously.
sentences.zh: 但民主党人，他们确实为认真对待这些案件、认真对待性虐待指控设定了非常高的标准。

sentences.en: Even Joe Biden has taken a strong position on this.
sentences.zh: 甚至乔·拜登也对此采取了坚定的立场。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's worth remembering the Kavanaugh hearings.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，卡耐瓦听证会是值得铭记的。

sentences.en: And one thing that Joe Biden said when that was all going on was this.
sentences.zh: 当时发生这一切时，乔·拜登说过的一件事就是这个。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: For a woman to come forward in the glaring lights of focus nationally, you've got to start off with the presumption that at least the essence of what she's talking about is real,
sentences.zh: 对于一个在全国瞩目的强光下站出来的女性，你必须从这样的推定开始：至少她所谈论的核心内容是真实的，

sentences.en: whether or not she forgets facts, whether or not it's been made worse or better over time.
sentences.zh: 不管她是否忘记了事实，不管随着时间的推移事情是被夸大了还是减弱了。

sentences.en: But nobody fails to understand that this is like jumping into a cauldron.
sentences.zh: 但没有人会不明白这就像跳进大熔炉一样。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So it's Biden himself saying, essentially, believe women.
sentences.zh: 所以是拜登本人在说，本质上就是相信女性。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Biden essentially saying believe women.
sentences.zh: 拜登本质上就是在说相信女性。

sentences.en: And I think that explains part of the approach to these allegations that you've seen from his campaign.
sentences.zh: 我认为这解释了你从他的竞选团队中看到的对这些指控的一部分应对方法。

sentences.en: Joe Biden himself has not spoken about them at all.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登本人根本没有谈论过这些。

sentences.en: And I don't think he's been asked directly, although I suppose that could come.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为没有人直接问过他，尽管我想这可能会发生。

sentences.en: But his campaign has been very careful in all their public statements to say that they believe women, that they think coming out like this is a credible thing to do.
sentences.zh: 但他的竞选团队在所有公开声明中都非常谨慎，表示他们相信女性，认为像这样站出来是一件可信的事情。

sentences.en: But in this case, they say the allegations are false.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，他们说指控是虚假的。

sentences.en: But they're really walking a tightrope when they talk about this politically with many in the base of the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 但当他们在政治上与民主党基层的许多人谈论此事时，他们确实是在走钢丝。

sentences.en: Well, help me understand that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，帮我理解这一点。

sentences.en: I mean, with all that history in mind that you just described of the Democratic Party setting such a high standard for itself,
sentences.zh: 我是说，考虑到你刚刚描述的民主党为自己设定了如此高的标准的全部历史，

sentences.en: and Biden himself, the presumptive Democratic nominee, saying believe women,
sentences.zh: 以及作为民主党假定总统候选人的拜登本人说要相信女性，

sentences.en: how is the Democratic establishment, how is the Democratic Party responding to what Tara Reade has alleged happened to her?
sentences.zh: 民主党建制派、民主党如何回应塔拉·里德声称发生在她身上的事情？

sentences.en: They're not responding.
sentences.zh: 他们没有回应。

sentences.en: Nobody in the Democratic establishment, elected officials, party leaders, has discussed this at all.
sentences.zh: 民主党建制派中的任何人、民选官员、党内领袖，都没有讨论过这件事。

sentences.en: Why do you think that is?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是为什么？

sentences.en: I mean, is that a function of the conflicting information here?
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是这里存在相互矛盾的信息的结果吗？

sentences.en: Is that party loyalty to the de facto nominee?
sentences.zh: 那是对事实上的候选人的党派忠诚吗？

sentences.en: Is that about the fact that there is just one of these accusations, not a pattern, as you just said?
sentences.zh: 是因为正如你刚才所说，这只有一个指控，而不是一种模式吗？

sentences.en: How do you explain that?
sentences.zh: 你如何解释这一点？

sentences.en: Well, honestly, I think it's some of all of that.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我认为这包含所有这些因素。

sentences.en: When I talk to people who are close to Joe Biden, and I've now talked to quite a lot of them, they say that this is something that's just so completely out of character for him.
sentences.zh: 当我与那些接近乔·拜登的人交谈时——我现在已经和相当多的人谈过了——他们说这完全不符合他的性格。

sentences.en: They describe a man who's fiercely devoted to his wife and his kids,
sentences.zh: 他们形容一个极其忠于妻子和孩子的男人，

sentences.en: that he would spend a lot of time focusing on when he could get the quickest train, the soonest train, home to Delaware so he could see them.
sentences.zh: 他会花很多时间关注什么时候能赶上最快、最早回特拉华州的火车以便去看望他们。

sentences.en: And they just cannot reconcile these allegations that are out with the guy that they have known for all these decades.
sentences.zh: 他们根本无法将现有的这些指控与他们几十年来认识的那个家伙调和起来。

sentences.en: So they say they can't believe it's true.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说他们无法相信这是真的。

sentences.en: But when you look at the political calendar, we're in the spring of an election year.
sentences.zh: 但当你看看政治日历，我们正处于选举年的春天。

sentences.en: Joe Biden is going to be the Democratic nominee.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登将成为民主党候选人。

sentences.en: So you have to figure that many, many Democrats also just don't want this to be true.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须明白，许多许多民主党人也只是不希望这是真的。

sentences.en: Lisa, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 丽莎，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: So today I am asking all Americans, I'm asking every Democrat, I'm asking every Independent,
sentences.zh: 所以今天我请求所有美国人，我请求每一位民主党人，我请求每一位独立人士，

sentences.en: and I'm asking a lot of Republicans to come together in this campaign to support your candidacy, which I endorse.
sentences.zh: 我请求许多共和党人在这场竞选活动中团结起来，支持我所支持的你的候选资格。

sentences.en: On Monday, Joe Biden was endorsed by his former rival, Senator Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 周一，乔·拜登获得了他的前竞争对手、参议员伯尼·桑德斯的支持。

sentences.en: Well, Bernie, I want to thank you for that.
sentences.zh: 好的，伯尼，我要为此谢谢你。

sentences.en: It's a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这很重要。

sentences.en: I think that your endorsement means a great deal.
sentences.zh: 我认为你的支持意义重大。

sentences.en: It means a great deal to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我的意义重大。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他事情。

sentences.en: On Monday, France said it would extend a nationwide lockdown until the middle of May.
sentences.zh: 周一，法国表示将把全国范围内的封锁延长至5月中旬。

sentences.en: Britain was expected to extend its lockdown.
sentences.zh: 英国预计将延长其封锁期。

sentences.en: And Russia's president offered his darkest assessment yet of the virus's impact there.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯总统对该病毒在那里的影响做出了迄今为止最黯淡的评估。

sentences.en: During a meeting with his advisers, Vladimir Putin said, quote,
sentences.zh: 在与顾问开会期间，弗拉基米尔·普京说，引述：

sentences.en: We see the situation changing daily and, unfortunately, not for the better.
sentences.zh: 我们看到局势每天都在变化，不幸的是，没有向好的方向发展。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Good afternoon to everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好。

sentences.en: Let me welcome my fellow governors who are on the telephone, who you'll hear from in a moment.
sentences.zh: 请允许我欢迎正在通电话的我的州长同僚们，你们一会儿就会听到他们的发言。

sentences.en: In the U.S., two groups of governors, one on the East Coast, the other on the West Coast,
sentences.zh: 在美国，两组州长，一组在东海岸，另一组在西海岸，

sentences.en: said they would decide regionally when and how to reopen their state's economies and emphasized that they would not do so until experts and data showed that it would be safe.
sentences.zh: 表示他们将按地区决定何时以及如何重新开放其州的经济，并强调在专家和数据证明安全之前他们不会这样做。

sentences.en: Again, we anticipate different facts, different circumstances for different states, different parts of states.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，我们预计不同的州、州内不同的地方会有不同的事实和不同的情况。

sentences.en: But let's be smart and let's be cooperative and let's learn from one another.
